hypothesis: Weekly-only decision cadence reduces costly dual-momentum churn, but can delay exits.
assessment: Cadence change merits independent validation for cost reduction, not automatic adoption: positive but small basket profit, increased drawdown versus baseline and extreme opportunity cost versus buy-and-hold. AAPL improvement is already-viewed evidence, not confirmation.
failures: Zero simulation failures. Lower decision frequency does not guarantee lower risk.
ledger_reason_caveat: Inherited signal_at_next_open reason text is used even for public close fills; actual fill reference is cl(t) for public data and op(t) only for prior AAPL, as frozen source/plan specify.
provenance_and_limitations: See task plan.json and data/provenance.json; source in Main.hs dispatch cycle=2 and common/Engine.hs. Shared dependent samples and correlated folds, no prospective evidence. summary.csv preserves annual blocks and individual symbols.
